channel.name: darj
channel.niche: colourful 2D cartoon nursery rhymes and sing-along songs for toddlers aged 1 to 5, in the style of the big kids' channels, but every video an original production
channel.audience: toddlers and their parents in India and worldwide, watching on a phone
channel.voiceStyle: You are a cheerful children's TV presenter performing a nursery rhyme for toddlers. Perform the lines below in a slow, bouncy, sing-song rhythm with very clear words, warm and playful, a tiny pause at the end of every line, and extra energy on repeated chorus lines. Do not read these instructions.

visuals.stylePrefix: cute 2D cartoon illustration for a children's nursery rhyme video, flat vector style, bold clean outlines, bright saturated pastel colours, big friendly eyes, soft rounded shapes, simple uncluttered background, high quality, no text, no letters, no watermark

categories.label: Classic public-domain nursery rhymes (traditional lyrics only)
seeds: If You're Happy and You Know It
Five Little Monkeys Jumping on the Bed

categories.label: Original sing-along rhymes about everyday toddler life
seeds: putting on shoes to go outside
a rainy day with an umbrella
riding a bicycle in the park

categories.label: Learning rhymes: numbers, colours, shapes, animal sounds, vehicles
seeds: vehicles and the sounds they make
big and small, fast and slow

formats.label: Sing-along with a repeated chorus
formats.structure: Two or three short verses, each followed by the same simple chorus. The chorus is the hook and appears at least 3 times.

formats.label: Counting rhyme
formats.structure: Something counts up or down one by one, one line per number, with a tiny event each time.

formats.label: Action rhyme
formats.structure: Every line tells the child to do a simple action (clap, jump, spin, touch your nose) that matches the words.

formats.label: Tiny story in rhyme
formats.structure: A character wants something, a small problem happens, a friend helps, happy ending. Rhyming couplets.
